description.value: Brackendale Bean is a café in the Brackendale neighbourhood of Squamish, a popular hub for cyclists tackling the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a potential rest stop for riders in all weather. OSM discovery notes suggest the business may now operate under the name Bean & Co at the same location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page fetch was blocked by a temporary rate-limit wall, returning no usable business content — effectively a fetch failure. All amenity and contact fields must rely solely on OSM tags, which confirm indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes but provide no bike, water, washroom, or other amenity data. The url_discovery_notes flag a potential rebranding to 'Bean & Co' at the same location, which is a notable concern.
concerns: Facebook page was temporarily blocked during fetch — no website content was retrievable; all amenities are unverified.
